title: Joseph of Copertino levitating during Mass
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Joseph of Copertino levitating during Mass, about 17th century at Italy, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: right Joseph of copertino was a 17th century friend Franciscan frier that would experience ecstatic Visions as a child and many people witnessed him levitating while participating in Mass

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Joseph of Copertino, a Franciscan friar in 17th-century Italy who, he says, had ecstatic visions as a child. According to Michels, many people saw him float in the air while taking part in Mass, the main Catholic church service. He brings it up as a case where religious history seems to hold the same strange events people report today.
